static_traits.name: Han Na
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends affected; avoiding social gatherings involving dancing; has a close friend but has not yet confided current troubles
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness yet; has not received psychotherapy in the past; no similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic; self-reported slight nervousness; high cooperativeness, willing to brainstorm and evaluate different interpretations

basic_info.main_problem: In recent months, I have persistently felt I am a terrible dance partner/teacher, and believe no one comes to my dance classes because I am not good enough. These feelings of inadequacy affect my confidence, making me feel anxious and self-doubting before every dance class or social situation involving dancing.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of inadequacy have already affected my enjoyment of dancing and overall confidence; I hope to improve this through counseling.
growth_experiences: Being criticized in a dance class a few months ago, since then directly linking criticism to self-worth: anxiety and self-doubt about ability before each class; believing no one attends because I am not good enough; gradually avoiding social gatherings involving dancing. Tried improving dance skills and received positive feedback, but still persistently feeling inadequate.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / I am a terrible dance partner and teacher
Others' attendance and evaluations determine my worth

special_situations.event: No one showing up for dance class
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no one comes to class, it means I am incompetent and teach poorly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practices twice as much and considers adjusting class times to prove himself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one comes because they do not like my teaching / I am terrible

special_situations.event: Being criticized in the last class
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If being criticized, it proves I am not good enough and unsuited to teach dance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Improves dance skills and proactively seeks positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is evidence that I am not good enough

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not dance well enough, others will look down on me or dislike me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social gatherings involving dancing to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible

special_situations.event: Still evaluates one's own ability after receiving positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only a perfect performance or a full class counts as good; otherwise positive feedback does not count
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These good reviews do not mean I am really good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and liked, affirmed as a dancer and teacher
core_conflict.fear: Fearing criticism and being negated; worrying that no one attending means I am not needed
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being negated through self-blame and avoidance

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, a dancer/teacher easily negated
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others/audiences (who will judge me by attendance and criticism)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing low attendance in dance classes or recalling being criticized
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others do not like me; I am not good enough (equating external circumstances with negation of the self)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Expressing in a self-blaming tone, using absolute terms (e.g., 'it is all because I am not good'), downplaying or ignoring external factors.

manifestations: Interpreting no one attending as being disliked
Having a close friend but unwilling to confide, worrying about 'bothering others'
outcomes: Social avoidance; trying fewer new activities

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Having a close friend to talk to but choosing not to confide, worrying about 'bothering others'
Mostly digesting anxiety internally rather than seeking help outwardly

positive_force: Actively improving dance skills, with action tendency
Willing to engage in problem-solving and brainstorming, able to consider external factors (weather, time conflicts, etc.)
Has some social support (one close friend)
Work performance not yet affected; daily functioning basically stable
negative_force: Tending toward personalization and mind reading, attributing low attendance to personal inadequacy
Mental filtering and overgeneralization, focusing on criticism and ignoring positive feedback
Anticipatory anxiety and self-doubt before classes or dance-related social events
Avoiding social gatherings; participating less in new activities and hobbies, further weakening confidence

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety and self-denial before dance classes and when receiving criticism
antecedent: No one attending dance class or low attendance
Before class or before dance-related social activities
target_behavior.core_reason: Directly equating others' attendance and criticism with self-worth, forming the core belief 'I am not good enough'
target_behavior.function: Escaping the threat of being negated, and maintaining a seemingly controllable interpretation through self-blame to reduce uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced enjoyment of dancing and overall confidence; persistent anxiety before each class

antecedent: Invitations to or plans for dance-related social activities
Thinking others may judge their dancing
target_behavior.core_reason: Anticipation of negative evaluation and shame, accompanied by mind-reading and catastrophizing tendencies
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential criticism and social discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Relationships with friends affected; fewer attempts at new activities and hobbies
